Name: Abigail HD Portraits by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]Purple hair. Black corset. Absolutely coming with you into the mines. 🖤
Our favorite sword-loving goth girl got a glow-up. [b]Abigail HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b] gives Abby a semi-realistic makeover with long violet waves, half-up space buns, pale lavender eyes, fuller lips, and a bustier, curvier silhouette.
Her everyday look features a fitted black corset top and choker, with a matching black-and-violet swimsuit for her island adventures. Because the goth wardrobe is absolutely coming on vacation.
For everyone whose ideal Stardew wife could beat them at video games, explore a haunted cave, and look ridiculously pretty doing both.[/color]
